desc: Redraw this little boar as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic boar proportions, same face, dark brown bristles with cream stripes, pink snout, small tusks, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on mane and tusks, subtle bristle shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
